important_findings: The Yuan domestic compendium contains explicit well, courtyard-standing-water and ditch-maintenance material; this is broader than later pure directional Feng Shui.
Yang Zhai Cuo Yao has a direct well-direction method tied to its own dragon/qi logic, so it must remain school-specific.
The same later source has water-path statements such as 水不宜直流 and 忌分流; applying these literally to modern plumbing would be a category error.
QCVN 01-1:2024/BYT is current from 2025-07-01 and replaced the 2018 domestic-water-quality regulation.
VSQI currently marks TCVN 4513:1988 and TCVN 4474:1987 active, while newer TCVN 13606:2023 and TCVN 7957:2023 cover external networks/facilities.
